notes.uri: the token's metadata, served by the site (site/metadata.json, a copy of launch/metadata/metadata.json), the user's choice on 2026-10-20. It is written on chain for good: site/metadata.json must never change or disappear, and the domain must be kept.
notes.symbol: also the ticker scripts/init-hunch.mjs stores in Hunch's state (initialize, for good): 1 to 10 characters, A-Z and 0-9 only. The diary names the coin by it
notes.devBuySol: 0.1 SOL, the user's choice on 2026-10-20. The buy rides inside step 2 (STEP=token) as the pool's first swap, after the creator transfer to the budget PDA, and the config turns on DBC's first-swap-with-min-fee so that this one buy pays 3.75% instead of the 50% opening fee (no outside trade can get it). Wrap the SOL first (the tool prints the spl-token wrap command) so the transaction fits.
notes.fixed: curveFeeBps, poolFeeBps, openingFeeBps, openingFeeSeconds, creatorSharePct, the LP split, decimals and metadataCanChange are compiled into the Hunch program (adopt_curve refuses any other config): the tool refuses values that differ
